patterns_discovered.description: All benchmark scripts follow consistent pattern: argparse CLI, --dry-run support, JSON output, --all-sizes for scaling tests
patterns_discovered.benefit: Maintainability and consistency across performance testing suite

patterns_discovered.description: Scripts detect missing dependencies (loguru, rank-bm25) and provide mock implementations or skip functionality
patterns_discovered.implementation: Try-except imports with fallback to mock logger classes
patterns_discovered.value: Scripts remain executable in constrained environments (PEP 668, no pip install)

patterns_discovered.description: File scanning shows consistent 2.6-3.1x speedup with os.walk() vs Path.rglob() across file scales
patterns_discovered.implication: Clear optimization target for Phase 3 file scanning pipeline

patterns_discovered.description: Six-phase plan with explicit dependencies: Phase 1 (baseline) → Phase 2 (database) → Phases 3-5 (parallelizable) → Phase 6 (verification)
patterns_discovered.parallelism: Max 2 parallel phases; Group 1: phases 1-2 together; estimated 1.4x speedup vs sequential
patterns_discovered.structure: Enables concurrent work on independent optimizations

patterns_discovered.description: Codebase follows repository pattern for database access and service pattern for business logic
patterns_discovered.relevance: Established patterns used for implementing optimizations (bulk_upsert, batch operations)

patterns_discovered.description: Project has 307 tests across 334 modules with pytest fixtures in conftest.py
patterns_discovered.scope: All optimizations require passing existing test suite
patterns_discovered.maintenance: Regression testing automated during optimization phases

gotchas_discovered.context: loguru and rank-bm25 libraries not installed in environment
gotchas_discovered.impact: Benchmark scripts cannot fully execute without fallback mechanisms
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Implemented mock loguru module and dry-run modes with graceful degradation
gotchas_discovered.prevention: Document dependency requirements; provide setup script (init.sh already exists)

gotchas_discovered.context: Python environment marked as externally-managed, preventing pip install
gotchas_discovered.impact: Cannot install missing dependencies through normal pip workflow
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Scripts work with dry-run mode; real environment setup handled separately
gotchas_discovered.lesson: Enterprise Python environments require alternative dependency management

gotchas_discovered.context: Connection problems prevented virtual environment setup during implementation
gotchas_discovered.impact: Cannot create isolated test environments for dependency testing
gotchas_discovered.workaround: Dry-run mode and mock implementations allow development without network access
gotchas_discovered.monitoring: Network reliability critical for Phase 2+ environment setup

gotchas_discovered.context: Importing from file_organizer.services.search triggered missing loguru in __init__.py
gotchas_discovered.impact: Direct module imports needed to avoid transitive dependency chains
gotchas_discovered.solution: Import BM25Index directly: from file_organizer.services.search.bm25_index import BM25Index
gotchas_discovered.pattern: Be explicit about import locations; avoid package __init__.py chains when possible

gotchas_discovered.context: rglob() loads all files into memory at once, causing memory/time degradation at scale
gotchas_discovered.impact: 50,000 files takes 0.1539s with rglob vs 0.0588s with os.walk
gotchas_discovered.severity: Critical for Phase 3 optimization - must replace with os.walk or streaming approach
gotchas_discovered.measure: Established in baseline; verify improvement in Phase 6

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: BM25 Index Persistence Not Yet Implemented
gotchas_discovered.context: Current implementation rebuilds BM25 index in-memory on each search
gotchas_discovered.impact: Search performance will degrade with larger document sets until index persistence added in Phase 4
gotchas_discovered.risk: Phase 4 must implement disk persistence before scaling to 100,000+ documents

gotchas_discovered.context: Current implementation hashes files individually without batch processing
gotchas_discovered.impact: Performance bottleneck for large file sets; 50,000 files will be slower than necessary
gotchas_discovered.target: Phase 5 implements batch hashing; baseline establishes current performance
gotchas_discovered.optimization: Switch from individual hashing to batch_size=1000 with concurrent processing

metrics_established.file_scanning: 1000/10000/50000 files with rglob vs os.walk comparison
metrics_established.search: BM25 indexing time and query latency across document counts
metrics_established.deduplication: Hashing time, duplicate detection, wasted space metrics

approach_outcome.readiness_for_next_phase: Phase 2 (Database Layer Optimization) ready to start - baseline established for measuring improvement

recommendations.recommendation: Replace Path.rglob() with os.walk() in Phase 3 file scanning pipeline
recommendations.rationale: Baseline shows consistent 2.6-3.1x speedup; verified across 1k-50k file scales
recommendations.impact: Addresses major bottleneck identified in build-progress.txt

recommendations.recommendation: Implement BM25 index persistence to disk in Phase 4
recommendations.rationale: Current in-memory rebuild on each search will degrade with 100,000+ documents

recommendations.recommendation: Add database indexes on file_metadata (name, mime_type, size_bytes) in Phase 2
recommendations.rationale: Current full table scans identified as bottleneck; indexes critical for scaling

recommendations.recommendation: Implement batch deduplication hashing in Phase 5
recommendations.rationale: Individual file hashing is inefficient; batch processing with concurrent execution needed

recommendations.recommendation: Continue benchmarking methodology across all optimization phases
recommendations.rationale: Established pattern (file_scanning_benchmark.py style) ensures consistent metrics
recommendations.apply_to: Phase 2-6 implementations for verification of improvements

recommendations.recommendation: Maintain build-progress.txt with detailed session notes per phase
recommendations.rationale: Current format valuable for tracking decisions and debugging; established pattern working well

recommendations.recommendation: Parallelize Phase 2 database optimization with Phase 4 search optimization
recommendations.rationale: Plan identifies these as parallel-safe; coordinated execution can 1.4x speedup total timeline
recommendations.coordination: Use --parallel 2 flag in auto-claude run command

recommendations.recommendation: Document environment setup requirements for dependencies (loguru, rank-bm25)
recommendations.rationale: PEP 668 and proxy issues prevented normal setup; explicit documentation needed
recommendations.reference: init.sh already exists; ensure all required packages documented there

recommendations.recommendation: Track memory usage during Phase 5 deduplication at 50,000 file scale
recommendations.rationale: Performance target requires staying below 500MB during batch processing
